nodes.name: Uruk Urban Revolution
nodes.label: Uruk Urban Revolution
nodes.description: Rapid urbanization in Uruk marking the rise of complex Mesopotamian city life, c. 3500–3000 BCE.

nodes.name: Formation of the Akkadian Empire
nodes.label: Formation of the Akkadian Empire
nodes.description: Sargon of Akkad unifies Mesopotamia into the first known empire, c. 2334 BCE.

nodes.name: Ur III Renaissance
nodes.label: Ur III Renaissance
nodes.description: Neo-Sumerian revival under the Third Dynasty of Ur, c. 2112–2004 BCE.

nodes.name: Fall of Nineveh
nodes.label: Fall of Nineveh
nodes.description: Coalition captures Assyrian capital Nineveh, ending the Neo-Assyrian Empire, 612 BCE.

nodes.name: Cyrus Takes Babylon
nodes.label: Cyrus Takes Babylon
nodes.description: Persian conquest of Babylon integrating Mesopotamia into the Achaemenid Empire, 539 BCE.

nodes.name: Battle of Gaugamela
nodes.label: Battle of Gaugamela
nodes.description: Alexander the Great defeats Darius III near Mosul, 331 BCE, ending Achaemenid rule.

nodes.name: Founding of Baghdad
nodes.label: Founding of Baghdad
nodes.description: Abbasid caliph al-Mansur establishes Baghdad as the new capital in 762 CE.

nodes.name: Zanj Rebellion
nodes.label: Zanj Rebellion
nodes.description: Major slave revolt in southern Iraq centered near Basra, 869–883 CE.

nodes.name: Sack of Baghdad
nodes.label: Sack of Baghdad
nodes.description: Mongol forces capture Baghdad, ending the Abbasid caliphate in 1258 CE.

nodes.name: Ottoman Capture of Baghdad (1534)
nodes.label: Ottoman Capture of Baghdad
nodes.description: Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent takes Baghdad, bringing Iraq under Ottoman rule.

nodes.name: Safavid Occupation of Baghdad (1623)
nodes.label: Safavid Occupation of Baghdad
nodes.description: Safavid forces seize Baghdad, intensifying Ottoman-Safavid conflict.

nodes.name: Ottoman Reconquest of Baghdad (1638)
nodes.label: Ottoman Reconquest of Baghdad
nodes.description: Murad IV retakes Baghdad, cementing Ottoman control of Iraq.

nodes.name: Iraq Independence (1932)
nodes.label: Iraq Independence
nodes.description: Iraq joins the League of Nations, ending British mandate control.

nodes.name: 1958 Iraqi Revolution
nodes.label: 1958 Iraqi Revolution
nodes.description: Military coup ends the monarchy and establishes a republic.

nodes.name: Ba'ath Coup of 1968
nodes.label: Ba'ath Coup of 1968
nodes.description: Ba'ath Party takes power, ushering in long-term authoritarian rule.

nodes.name: 2003 Iraq War
nodes.label: 2003 Iraq War
nodes.description: U.S.-led invasion topples Saddam Hussein and triggers major political transformation.

nodes.name: ISIS Capture of Mosul
nodes.label: ISIS Capture of Mosul
nodes.description: ISIS seizes Mosul in 2014, prompting major conflict and humanitarian crisis.

nodes.name: Tishreen Protests (2019)
nodes.label: Tishreen Protests
nodes.description: Nationwide protests demanding reform, services, and an end to corruption.
